enforcedBy: the naming gate, which refuses a filename whose last segment before the extension is an undeclared tag or differs from its folder's tag

check.population: every filename whose concern slot holds the tag, and the folder holding each such file
check.freshness: a verdict stands until a file carrying the tag is created, moved or renamed, or the declared vocabulary changes
check.refusal: the lint run fails a file whose tag is undeclared or disagrees with its folder
check.observation: each filename parsed by position against the declared concern vocabulary
check.evidence: fires-and-accepts: a suite lints a file whose tag is undeclared and one whose tag differs from its folder, and passes a conforming file
check.authority: the declared concern vocabulary, which a filename's tag and its folder conform to

records.name: Reader Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that reads a stored or external format into structure the system works with, filed in a readers folder.

records.name: Writer Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that writes structure out to a stored or external format, filed in a writers folder.

records.name: Converter Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that turns one representation into another of the same content, filed in a converters folder.

records.name: Formatter Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that lays data out as text in a target format such as Markdown, JSON or source code, filed in a formatters folder.

records.name: Normalizer Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that brings varied input to one canonical form before it is compared or stored, filed in a normalizers folder.

records.name: Sanitizer Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that removes or escapes the parts of untrusted input that could do harm, filed in a sanitizers folder.

records.name: Mapper Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that maps the fields of one model onto another, filed in a mappers folder.

records.name: Transformer Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that maps an input state to an output state, including a fix that rewrites a file, filed in a transformers folder.

records.name: Pipeline Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that chains processing stages so each consumes the one before, filed in a pipelines folder.

records.name: Source Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that produces the records a pipeline starts from, filed in a sources folder.

records.name: Sink Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that receives the records a pipeline ends with, filed in a sinks folder.

records.name: Processor Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that applies one processing operation to each item that passes through it, filed in a processors folder.

records.name: Filter Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that keeps the items meeting a condition and drops the rest, filed in a filters folder.

records.name: Validator Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that decides whether its input is valid and reports why it is not, filed in a validators folder.

records.name: Matcher Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that tests whether a value fits a shape and reports what it matched, filed in a matchers folder.

records.name: Aggregator Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that combines many items into one summary value, filed in an aggregators folder.

records.name: Comparator Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that decides the order or the difference between two values, filed in a comparators folder.

records.name: Sorter Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that arranges a set of items in an order a comparison defines, filed in a sorters folder.

records.name: Iterator Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that yields the members of a set one at a time, filed in an iterators folder.

records.name: Generator Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that produces values or files from a description of them, filed in a generators folder.

records.name: Analyzer Tag

distinctFrom.reason: An analyzer derives facts across a body of material, while an inspector reports what one artifact holds.

records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that reads a body of material and derives facts about it without judging it, filed in an analyzers folder.

records.name: Inspector Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that looks into one artifact and reports what it holds, filed in an inspectors folder.

records.name: Key Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that creates, holds or rotates cryptographic keys, filed in a keys folder.

records.name: Hashing Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that computes fixed-size fingerprints of content, filed in a hashing folder.

records.name: Digest Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that computes a cryptographic summary of content for integrity checks, filed in a digests folder.

records.name: Randomness Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that supplies random values from a declared and, where needed, seeded source, filed in a randomness folder.

records.name: Lexer Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that splits source text into tokens, filed in a lexers folder.

records.name: Parser Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that builds a syntax tree from tokens by a grammar, filed in a parsers folder.

records.name: Grammar Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that declares the productions a language is parsed by, filed in a grammars folder.

records.name: Visitor Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that walks a syntax tree and acts on each node kind it meets, filed in a visitors folder.

records.name: Pass Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that performs one full traversal of a program or a frame to transform or render it, filed in a passes folder.

records.name: Extractor Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that pulls the records a transformation needs out of a larger source, filed in an extractors folder.

records.name: Partition Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that splits a data set into parts processed or stored separately, filed in a partitions folder.

records.name: Grid Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a regular division of space into cells, filed in a grids folder.

records.name: Tile Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines one cell of a tiled world and what occupies it, filed in a tiles folder.

records.name: Collider Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a shape used to detect when two objects touch, filed in a colliders folder.

records.name: Bounds Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that computes the extents enclosing an object or a region, filed in a bounds folder.

records.name: Raycast Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that finds what a line through space hits first, filed in a raycasts folder.

records.name: Animation Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines how a value or a pose changes over a span of time, filed in an animations folder.

records.name: Easing Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that maps linear progress onto a curve of acceleration and deceleration, filed in an easings folder.

records.name: Curve Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a parametric path or response curve, filed in a curves folder.

records.name: Tween Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that interpolates a value between two endpoints over time, filed in a tweens folder.

records.name: Trajectory Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that computes the path a moving object follows under its forces, filed in a trajectories folder.

records.name: Path Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that finds or defines a route between two points, filed in a paths folder.

records.name: Formation Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that arranges a group of agents in a shape relative to a leader, filed in a formations folder.
